title: Cambridge Fetal Thymus Dissociation
author: Jongeun Park
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wedfba6
materials: Use scalpel to carry minced tissue
in case large mesh is still visible
Count cells to determine resuspension volume
Freeze all remaining cells using cell stock solution

steps.title: Prepare solutions
steps.instruction: Make digestion solution: 5 mL PBS + 100 µL Librase TH (2.5 mg/mL stock, 50×, final 50 µg/mL). Make stop solution: 40 mL PBS + 800 µL FBS (final 2 % FBS in PBS).

steps.title: Sanitize biosafety hood
steps.instruction: Wipe the hood interior with 70 % ethanol and allow to dry.

steps.title: Prepare tissue
steps.instruction: Place fetal thymus tissue onto a petri dish inside the hood, remove attached fat and other impurities, and mince the tissue.

steps.title: Transfer tissue to tube
steps.instruction: Place minced tissue into a 15 mL Falcon tube containing 5 mL digestion solution; avoid using pipette tips as they may become sticky.

steps.title: Rinse scalpel
steps.instruction: Rinse the scalpel with digestion solution and transfer any remaining tissue fragments into the same Falcon tube.

steps.title: First enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a 37 °C water bath for 30 min.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and add trypsin
steps.instruction: After incubation, carefully remove the supernatant and set aside. To the remaining tissue, add 4 mL 0.25 % Trypsin solution together with 1 mL of the previous digestion mixture.

steps.title: Second enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube again at 37 °C for 20–30 min.

steps.title: Quench digestion
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL stop solution to the 5 mL of dissociated tissue/digestion mixture.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Spin the filtrate at 750 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: RBC lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL 1× RBC lysis buffer (catalog 00‑4300‑54).

steps.title: Wash with stop solution
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL stop solution (2 % FBS in PBS) to the lysate.

steps.title: Second filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the suspension again through a 40 µm strainer.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at 750 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in an appropriate volume of PBS as determined by cell counting.

steps.title: Final wash and count
steps.instruction: Wash once more with stop solution, count the cells, and resuspend in the desired final volume.
